name: ormqr
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::ormqr(Tensor self, Tensor input2, Tensor input3, bool left=True, bool transpose=False) -> Tensor. Applies the orthogonal matrix represented by Householder reflectors in self and input2 to input3. Coverage spans square, rectangular and batched matrices, both left and right application, transpose and non-transpose modes, and invalid reflector dimensions. The operation does not mutate or alias its inputs.
